title: My Favorite Subject
summary: Siswa belajar nama mata pelajaran, kata sifat untuk menilainya, serta menyampaikan pendapat dan alasan dengan pola I think … because ….
content:
## Tujuan Belajar

• Menyebutkan nama-nama mata pelajaran sekolah dalam bahasa Inggris.
• Mendeskripsikan mata pelajaran dengan kata sifat seperti fun, difficult, dan useful.
• Menyatakan pendapat tentang mata pelajaran dan memberi alasan dengan "because".
• Bertanya dan menjawab "Which subject do you think is …?"

## Kosakata Inti

Di unit ini kamu belajar nama mata pelajaran (English, biology, physics, chemistry, geography, history, social studies, P.E.) dan kata sifat untuk menilainya. Kata sifat positif: fun, interesting, amazing, useful, enjoyable. Kata sifat negatif: boring, difficult, confusing.

My favorite subject is biology because it's interesting.
I think chemistry is confusing, but physics is fun.
Geography is useful because we learn about the world.

## Tata Bahasa: because dan I think …

"Because" (karena) menghubungkan pendapat dengan alasannya. Satu mata pelajaran dianggap satu benda, jadi kita memakai "it's", bukan "he" atau "they're". Untuk menyatakan pendapat, pakai pola: I think + mata pelajaran + is + kata sifat + because + alasan. Ingat, untuk he / she kata kerjanya mendapat -s (thinks, likes), dan pertanyaan "Why" memakai do / does.

What is your favorite subject? → My favorite subject is … because it's …
Why do you like …? / Why does she like …?
Which subject do you think is …? → I think … is … because …

My favorite subject is English because it's fun.
I like history because we learn about the past.
Why does he like P.E.? He likes P.E. because he can play games.
I think physics is difficult because we have to remember many formulas.
She thinks social studies is useful because she learns about people.

## Contoh Percakapan

Bima: Hi, Laila! What is your favorite subject?
Laila: My favorite subject is biology because it's amazing.
Bima: Really? I think biology is confusing.
Laila: Why do you think so?
Bima: Because there are too many new words. I like P.E. because we can play football.
Laila: Which subject do you think is boring?
Bima: Hmm, I think history is boring.
Laila: I don't agree. I think history is interesting because we learn about the past.
Bima: OK! And which subject do you think is useful?
Laila: English! It's useful because we can talk to people around the world.

## Ayo Berlatih

What is your favorite subject? Why?
Contoh: My favorite subject is math because it's fun.

Which subject do you think is difficult?
Contoh: I think chemistry is difficult because we have to remember many formulas.

Why do you like English?
Contoh: I like English because it's useful.

Which subject does your friend think is boring?
Contoh: My friend thinks geography is boring.

## Tips

• Buat kartu kosakata: tulis nama mata pelajaran di satu sisi dan kata sifat yang cocok di sisi lainnya, lalu buat satu kalimat pendapat setiap hari.

• Saat menjawab pertanyaan "Why", selalu mulai dengan "because" dan berikan alasan yang jelas.

questions.q: Choose the correct ending: Mina likes English because …
questions.passage:
Mina and Tom are walking home after school. Mina says, “I really like English because it’s fun and we read amazing stories.”

Tom replies, “I like science. It’s interesting, but sometimes it’s difficult.”

Mina nods. “Yes, science can be confusing, but it’s also useful. It helps us understand the world around us.”

Tom smiles. “That’s true! But my favorite subject is P.E. because we can run and play games.”

They arrive at Tom’s house. “See you tomorrow!” Mina says.

“Goodbye!” Tom answers.

they can run and play games.

notes: Part 1A: tes ini tidak punya butir Example, jadi ke-6 butir pencocokan dimasukkan sebagai pilihan ganda 4 opsi (dari daftar arti a–f), posisi jawaban diacak. Part 1B: 'math' (juga menerima 'maths') dan 'art' (Part 2B) tidak termasuk Key Vocabulary di Teacher's Guide, tetapi dipertahankan sesuai tes. Part 2A dikonversi menjadi pilihan ganda 2 opsi sesuai urutan asli; Part 2B (pilih a/b) menjadi pilihan ganda dengan dua kalimat sebagai opsi. Part 3 aslinya mencocokkan awal kalimat (1–5) dengan akhiran (a–e); dikonversi menjadi READING pilihan ganda dengan 5 opsi akhiran yang sama (urutan asli a–e) di setiap butir. Ejaan 'favourite' (soal 4) vs 'favorite' (teks) dibiarkan seperti di tes. Akhiran d 'it helps her understand the world' sedangkan di teks Mina berkata 'It helps us understand the world' – kunci tetap d sesuai PDF. Semua kunci dicek terhadap PDF ANSWER (Part 1A: b, e, f, c, a, d; Part 1B: math, English, geography, biology, fun, history, language, interesting, difficult; Part 2A: is, it's, does, likes, it's; Part 2B: a, b, b, b, b; Part 3: e, b, d, c, a). Total 30 butir = 30 poin tes. Tidak ada soal bergambar.
